Cut Hamlet Captain, Avacyn's Pilgrim (no white use), Skaab Goliath and the non-creature green filler to fit 23 spells with 17 lands (10 Forest, 7 Island).

W/B deck: black is deepest (Bloodline Keeper, Reaper, Morkrut Banshee, Stromkirk Patrol) with white for Rebuke, Spectral Rider, Voiceless Spirit and humans. Cut red, green, and the weakest filler; 17 lands at 9 Swamp and 8 Plains.

Building W/U fliers with the strongest white and blue playables: Stitched Drake, Abbey Griffin, Chapel-style tempo creatures, Claustrophobia, Rebuke, Smite, Feeling of Dread and two Ghostly Possession as removal. Cut Lost in the Mist, Dissipate and the mill cards to keep a low curve with 17 lands.

…and black has only four playables, so I'm switching to U/R for its four removal and burn spells (Geistflame, Brimstone Volley, Into the Maw, Traitorous Blood). The deck is 10 creatures, 13 spells, and 17 lands, cutting the second Curse, Mask-style filler, and the weaker white and black cards.

…Lunge, Prey Upon, Spidery Grasp x2), fliers (Screeching Bat, Orchard Spirit, Vampire Interloper, Somberwald Spider), and Galvanic Juggernaut as a finisher. Cut Avacyn's Pilgrim (only makes white), the red and white cards, and the situational green cards; 10 Forest/7 Swamp for the heavier green.

…W/U: efficient white creatures, Fiend Hunter, Smite and Feeling of Dread, with blue for Claustrophobia, Sensory Deprivation, Invisible Stalker and Occultist. Cut Lost in the Mist, Nevermore, Balefire Dragon and the red cards to keep the blue splash-free; 10 Plains and 7 Islands for the WW costs.

Red-black aggro with 23 red-heavy spells, Olivia and Bloodgift Demon as the top end, and Devil's Play, Harvest Pyre and Blazing Torch for removal. Cut the defender, the white and blue cards, and the weak self-damage and mill options; Stensia Bloodhall counts as the 17th land.

Black-red midrange: Olivia, the removal (Volley, Geistflame, Harvest Pyre), and a solid creature curve, with Desperate Ravings as the 23rd card over the marginal curses. Black is the deeper colour, so it gets the extra Swamp.
